# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Lunchtime volatility contraction often precedes an afternoon expansion breakout; entering on the breakout with volume confirmation captures the move. This edge exists because market participants often pause during lunch, leading to a coiled spring effect that releases in the afternoon with increased participation.

## Mechanism

Compute 5-period ATR; if between 11:30-13:30 ET the ATR(5) contracts to ≤ 0.5× ATR(20) (measured over the prior 20 periods) AND price stays inside the range defined by the window’s highest high and lowest low, THEN after 13:30 ET, if price closes above the window high with volume ≥ 1.5× the average volume of the last 20 bars, enter long; if price closes below the window low with volume ≥ 1.5× average volume, enter short. Exit shape: Initial stop at the opposite edge of the compression window (for long, stop at window low; for short, stop at window high) or 0.6% whichever tighter; target 2R; upon reaching 1R move stop to break‑even then trail with chandelier at 1.2×ATR(14). Regime hint: Works best when VIX is between 12‑20 (moderate volatility) and there is no major macro event; avoid days where the opening range already exceeds 0.4% of price.
